verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is an AI writing and editing aid ('Use AI to help write or edit content'). That is an adjacent content-generation feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's board data. The MCP server lets external AI tools connect to Trello, which is not an in-product insights capability. No evidence shows Trello analyzing user data to surface insights or recommendations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
